Basic Information

  • Project Title: AI-Assisted Modelling of Flow and Compaction of Refractory Metal Powders
  • Host Institution: University of Leeds
  • School/Faculty: Faculty of Engineering and Physical Sciences
  • Disciplines: Computer Science, Materials Science, Engineering
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Application Deadline: 30 September 2026 at 05:00 UTC+5
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded (EPSRC)
  • Eligibility: UK Only
  • Location: Leeds, United Kingdom
  • IELTS Required: Yes

Research position overview

This project is part of the EPSRC Faculty with Industry Doctoral Training Partnership Award 2026/27. It focuses on using AI and modelling to understand the flow and compaction behaviour of refractory metal powders, which are critical for high-performance manufacturing.

Research Context

Refractory metals (e.g., tungsten, molybdenum) are used in extreme environments, but their powder processing is challenging. AI-assisted models can accelerate process optimisation.

What You Will Do

You will develop machine-learning models to simulate powder flow and compaction, validate them with experiments, and collaborate with industrial partners to translate findings into practice.

Key Research Aims

  • Build high-fidelity models for powder flow and compaction.
  • Apply AI techniques to predict process outcomes.
  • Improve efficiency and quality in powder metallurgy.

Supervisor Profile

Supervisor information is not provided. Please check the School of Engineering website for relevant academics.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Academic Background: First-class or 2:1 Honours degree (or equivalent) in computer science, materials science, engineering, or a related field.
  • English Language: IELTS required.
  • Nationality: UK only.

Funding Details

  • Funding Type: EPSRC DTP studentship.
  • Stipend: £21,805 per year.
  • Duration: 3.5 years.
  • Fees: Full academic fees covered.

How to Apply

Apply online via the University of Leeds PhD application portal.
